dsh-better-deepseek 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。[Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。

posts.en:
dsh-better-deepseek is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bridge plugin for the [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome extension: exposes HTTP handshake and session-filtered SSE event streams over the web server, enabling browser-extension UI integrations with DeepSeek Harness.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1d9a33be003f21747042.html
